content: Purpose of TimingExtensionResource The purpose of the TimingExtensionResource is to subsume a number of re-usable elements, like instance references to various timing relevant elements, that are referenced from within a TimingConditionFormula . These elements of a TimingExtensionResource are related to the context of the aggregating  parent  TimingExtension .
